## Setup
```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)

fd_data <- read.csv("all_fd_reporting_coverage_with_population_density.csv")

fd_data <- fd_data %>%
  mutate(
    coverage_72 = reported_months / 72 * 100,
    missing_72 = 72 - reported_months,
    log_population = log10(population_2025),
    log_density = log10(population_density_per_sq_mile)
  )

nfirs <- read.csv("va_nfirs_2020_2025_373FDs.csv")

```

## Overall reporting coverage vs population
```{r}
ggplot(fd_data, aes(x = population_2025,
                    y = coverage_72)) +
  geom_point(color = "salmon4", alpha = 0.6, size = 2.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "rosybrown3") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = comma) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "Overall Reporting Coverage vs. Population",
    subtitle = "January 2020 - December 2025",
    x = "County/City Population (Log Scale)",
    y = "Percentage of 72 Months Reported"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = -Inf,
    label = paste0("r = ", round(
      cor(fd_data$log_population, fd_data$coverage_72,
          use = "complete.obs"), 3
    )),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = -1,
    size = 5
  )
```

## Coverage by population density category

```{r}
fd_data <- fd_data %>%
  mutate(
    density_group = factor(
      ntile(population_density_per_sq_mile, 4),
      levels = 1:4,
      labels = c("Lowest Density", "Low-Medium",
                 "High-Medium", "Highest Density")
    )
  )

ggplot(fd_data, aes(x = density_group,
                    y = coverage_72)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "rosybrown3",
    color = "salmon4",
    alpha = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.4,
    color = "salmon4",
    size = 2
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "Reporting Coverage by Population Density",
    subtitle = "January 2020 - December 2025",
    x = "Population Density Category",
    y = "Percentage of 72 Months Reported"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1)
  )

fd_data %>%
  group_by(density_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_coverage = mean(coverage_72, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_coverage = median(coverage_72, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
```

## FD x Month Reporting

```{r}
# 1. Extract month and year from incident date
nfirs_monthly <- nfirs %>%
  mutate(
    incident_date = as.Date(
      sprintf("%08d", INC_DATE),
      format = "%m%d%Y"
    ),
    month = floor_date(incident_date, "month")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(month),
    month >= as.Date("2020-01-01"),
    month <= as.Date("2025-12-01")
  )

# 2. Keep only departments in your reporting dataset
monthly_reporting <- nfirs_monthly %>%
  semi_join(fd_data, by = "FDID") %>%
  distinct(FDID, month) %>%
  mutate(reported = "Reported")

# 3. Create all FD x month combinations
all_months <- seq(
  as.Date("2020-01-01"),
  as.Date("2025-12-01"),
  by = "month"
)

heatmap_data <- monthly_reporting %>%
  complete(
    FDID = unique(fd_data$FDID),
    month = all_months,
    fill = list(reported = "No records")
  )

# 4. Create the heatmap
ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = month, y = factor(FDID),
                         fill = reported)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Reported" = "salmon4",
      "No records" = "grey90"
    ),
    name = "Reporting Status"
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "6 months",
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly NFIRS Reporting by Fire Department",
    subtitle = "January 2020 - December 2025",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Fire Department"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```

##

```{r}
monthly_counts <- heatmap_data %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(
    reporting_fds = sum(reported == "Reported"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(monthly_counts,
       aes(x = month, y = reporting_fds)) +
  geom_line(color = "salmon4", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "salmon4", size = 1.5) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "6 months",
    date_labels = "%b %Y"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 350, 50)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 350)) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Fire Departments Reporting Each Month",
    subtitle = "January 2020 - December 2025",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Number of FDs With Incident Records"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

monthly_counts %>%
  arrange(reporting_fds) %>%
  head(10)

```

##

```{r}
# Identify consecutive months without incident records
missing_streaks <- heatmap_data %>%
  arrange(FDID, month) %>%
  group_by(FDID) %>%
  mutate(
    is_missing = reported == "No records",
    streak_id = cumsum(
      is_missing != lag(is_missing, default = first(is_missing))
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(FDID, streak_id, is_missing) %>%
  summarise(
    streak_length = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(is_missing)

# Plot the distribution
ggplot(missing_streaks, aes(x = streak_length)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 1,
    boundary = 0.5,
    fill = "salmon4",
    color = "rosybrown3",
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, 6)) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Consecutive Months Without Incident Records",
    subtitle = "January 2020 - December 2025",
    x = "Consecutive Months Without Records",
    y = "Number of Missing-Month Streaks"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

```

## Reporting Streaks

```{r}
reporting_streaks <- heatmap_data %>%
  mutate(FDID = as.character(FDID)) %>%
  arrange(FDID, month) %>%
  group_by(FDID) %>%
  mutate(
    is_reporting = reported == "Reported",
    streak_id = cumsum(
      is_reporting != lag(is_reporting, default = first(is_reporting))
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(FDID, streak_id, is_reporting) %>%
  summarise(
    streak_length = n(),
    start_month = min(month),
    end_month = max(month),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(is_reporting)


fd_streak_summary <- reporting_streaks %>%
  group_by(FDID) %>%
  summarise(
    longest_streak = max(streak_length),
    average_streak = mean(streak_length),
    number_of_streaks = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  right_join(
    fd_data %>% mutate(FDID = as.character(FDID)) %>%
      select(FDID, reported_months, coverage_72),
    by = "FDID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    longest_streak = replace_na(longest_streak, 0),
    average_streak = replace_na(average_streak, 0),
    number_of_streaks = replace_na(number_of_streaks, 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(FDID))

head(fd_streak_summary, 20)

```

## Reporting Streak Distribution
```{r}

ggplot(fd_streak_summary, aes(x = longest_streak)) +

  ) +

    subtitle = "January 2020 - December 2025",
    x = "Longest Consecutive Reporting Streak (Months)",

```

## Summary Table

```{r}

streak_stats <- fd_streak_summary %>%
  summarise(
    total_fds = n(),
    mean_longest_streak = mean(longest_streak),
    median_longest_streak = median(longest_streak),
    min_longest_streak = min(longest_streak),
    max_longest_streak = max(longest_streak),
    mean_number_of_streaks = mean(number_of_streaks),
    median_number_of_streaks = median(number_of_streaks)
  )

streak_stats

```



## Setup v2
```{r}
nfirs_eda <- nfirs %>%
  mutate(
    incident_date = as.Date(
      sprintf("%08d", INC_DATE),
      format = "%m%d%Y"
    ),
    hour = as.integer(substr(ALARM, 1, 2)),
    day_of_week = lubridate::wday(incident_date, label = TRUE,
                                  week_start = 1),
    month = floor_date(incident_date, "month")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(incident_date),
    !is.na(hour),
    hour >= 0,
    hour <= 23,
    incident_date >= as.Date("2020-01-01"),
    incident_date < as.Date("2026-01-01")
  )

```


## Heatmap of call volume by day of week and hour of day

```{r}


weekly_hourly <- nfirs_eda %>%
  count(day_of_week, hour, name = "total_calls") %>%
  complete(
    day_of_week,
    hour = 0:23,
    fill = list(total_calls = 0)
  )

ggplot(weekly_hourly,
       aes(x = hour, y = day_of_week,
           fill = total_calls)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "mistyrose",
    high = "deeppink4",
    labels = comma
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 23, 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Fire/EMS Call Volume by Day and Hour",
    subtitle = "Virginia, 2020-2025",
    x = "Hour of Day",
    y = "Day of Week",
    fill = "Total Calls"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

```
